mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in GDPC1 (demand) signals stronger economic activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns over 60 days are not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances with sustained GDPC1 growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3.5% triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day SPX returns negative in > 70% of triggered instances despite UNRATE below 3.5%, or p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent upward movement in quarterly demand (GDPC1) and accommodative monetary policy (FEDFUNDS decline) signals a supportive economic environment, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 up 2% AND FEDFUNDS down 1% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies move as predicted, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained upward trend in INDPRO (production index) over 60 days indicates expanding supply, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: 60-day SPX returns not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in > 60% of instances with sustained INDPRO growth.

mechanism_narrative: A one-time surge in INDPRO above 105 triggers positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns negative in > 70% of triggered instances despite INDPRO crossing above 105, or p-value > 0.05.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment (PAYEMS) and concurrent demand growth (GDPC1) both increasing signal a robust economy, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS up 5k AND GDPC1 up 2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 20-day returns not significantly positive when both proxies rise as predicted, or interaction effect rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-month window.

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle, an increase in FEDFUNDS above 4.5% triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns positive in > 60% of triggered instances during tightening cycles, or p-value > 0.05 when FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A sudden drop in UNRATE below 3.0% triggers positive S&P 500 returns within the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns negative in > 70% of triggered instances despite UNRATE below 3.0%, or p-value > 0.05.
